text:
ashwin: Heads-up — I sketched a refactor for the proxy <-> quota service boundary. want quick feedback before i turn it into an RFC.
maria: ping the infra folks, curious about the caching/consistency tradeoff.
sanjay: skimmed it. main question: do we let proxies make provisional admits (local tokens) or require central token checkout for every request?
emily: provisional admits are great for tail latency but make fairness harder across proxies. central checkout is simpler logically but spikes latency.
ashwin: exact tradeoff. proposal: proxies keep short-lived local credit leases (50–200ms), fall back to central when exhausted. central remains authoritative for long-term accounting.
taylor: what about abuse detection? if we allow local admits, a noisy client could spin many proxies and amplify.
ashwin: plan includes per-proxy token humidity signals back to central (sampling). also ephemeral nonce binding so central can revoke quickly.
maria: can we model amplification risk? we should set a cap on cross-proxy aggregate admit rate and a quick reclaim path.
sanjay: +1 on cap. suggestion: maintain per-tenant global smoothing window (approximate) in central and reject leases that would exceed it.
emily: telemetry needs: per-lease origin, lease-size, heuristic score, and latency delta when central fallback occurs. can we reuse ingress metrics?
ashwin: yes — piggyback on existing ingress tags. example event:

```
lease.issued tenant=acme size=20ms origin=proxy-17 reason=burst
lease.revoked tenant=acme cause=revocation-rate-limit
```

taylor: rollout plan?
ashwin: start with internal tenants, opt-in via config; canary 1% of proxies, 24h observation, then 10% if no SLO regressions. auto-disable if error-rate or token-drift > threshold.
maria: how do we handle cross-data-center fairness? leases shouldn't let one DC starve another.
sanjay: central should do DC-aware budgeting. proxies request dc-scoped leases and central enforces DC quotas and a global backstop.
emily: code surface: small proxy API change: Add LeaseRequest proto + LeaseStatus. sample:

```
message LeaseRequest { string tenant = 1; int32 units = 2; string dc = 3; }
message LeaseStatus { bool granted = 1; int32 granted_units = 2; int64 expires_at = 3; }
```

ashwin: yeah. keep the api minimal. proxies still call central for reserves > threshold.
taylor: testing: synthetic burst harness, multi-proxy noise injection, and tenant fairness checker. we should add chaos tests that revoke leases mid-flight.
maria: ops playbook: how to triage when central is the bottleneck? add a quick toggle to set proxy-lease-size=0 to force central-only mode.
ashwin: adding to playbook.
ashwin: final ask: quick ack if folks are ok with leases + central backstop approach. also any bright ideas to reduce amplification risk?
sanjay: ack, good plan. consider a client-binding token (session id) so proxies can rate-limit at connection-level.
emily: ack. add a decay window for lease refill to avoid synchronized renewals.
taylor: ack. i'll draft the rollout checklist and the tests.
ashwin: thanks all — i'll convert to RFC early next week and include an experimental metric dashboard widget for lease churn.
devops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rollout scheduled: proxies-canary-set-5 @ 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z :rocket:
